name: Add New Page to Cloud Dashboard
description: Add a new page to the React cloud dashboard with routing, navigation, and optional API integration.

page_description.description: Brief description of what the page does

route_path.description: URL path for the page (kebab-case, e.g., 'activity-insights')

requires_api.description: Whether the page needs API integration

api_endpoint.description: Backend API endpoint if requires_api is true (e.g., '/v2/activities/insights')

design_notes.description: Notes about the page design, layout, components to use

tasks.description: Study existing dashboard pages to understand patterns

prompt.template:
Examine existing dashboard pages to understand the structure:

1. Read a few example pages:
   - repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/src/pages/APIKeys.tsx
   - repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/src/pages/Members.tsx
   - repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/src/pages/UsageAnalytics.tsx

2. Note the common patterns:
   - How they import components (from @/components/...)
   - How they use API clients (from @/lib/api/...)
   - How they handle loading/error states
   - How they structure the page layout
   - What UI components they use (Card, Table, Button, etc.)

3. Check the App.tsx routing to see how pages are registered

4. Summarize the patterns found.

tasks.description: Add the page to the routing configuration
Add the page to the navigation menu

prompt.template:
Add navigation link for the new page:

File: repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/src/components/Layout.tsx

1. Find the navigation menu section
2. Add a new navigation item following the existing pattern
3. The nav item should:
   - Have an appropriate icon (choose from existing or use a placeholder)
   - Display the label: {{nav_label}}
   - Navigate to: {{route_path}}
   - Highlight when active

Follow the same structure as existing nav items.

tasks.description: Add API client functions if needed

prompt.template:
{{if requires_api}}
Add API client functions:

1. Read the existing API client to understand the pattern:
   File: repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/src/lib/api/analysis-api.ts

2. Add new functions for {{api_endpoint}}:
   - Create appropriate function names (e.g., getInsights, createInsight)
   - Use the get, post, put, del helpers from client.ts
   - Add proper TypeScript types for request/response
   - Follow RESTful conventions

3. If needed, add TypeScript types in:
   File: repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/src/types/api.ts

{{else}}
Skip this task - no API integration needed.
{{endif}}

tasks.description: Test the new page locally if dashboard is running

prompt.template:
Test the new page:

1. Check if dashboard is running locally (port 3000)
2. If running:
   - Open browser to http://localhost:3000
   - Navigate to the new page via the navigation menu
   - Verify it loads without errors
   - Check browser console for errors
3. If not running:
   - Note that testing should be done after deployment
   - Or start the dashboard with: cd repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard && bun dev

Report any issues found.

success_criteria: Page component created with proper structure
API client functions added if required
